beats.visual_focus: Chalkboard showing a rigid 3x3 convolution kernel shattering into digital glass fragments as clean transformer attention vectors slice through.

beats.text: Standard convolutional networks suffer from severe tunnel vision. They slide tiny three-by-three filters across pixels. Struggling to connect distant visual cues.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing 3x3 green box slowly crawling across a 224x224 pixel grid, trapped in local pixels while red dashed lines fail to bridge opposite corners.

visual_blueprint.title: THE BOTTLENECK: LOCAL RECEPTIVE FIELDS
visual_blueprint.sub: Sliding windows cannot resolve global scene topology

motif_params.title: THE BOTTLENECK: LOCAL RECEPTIVE FIELDS
motif_params.sub: Sliding windows cannot resolve global scene topology

beats.text: The Vision Transformer ditches convolutions entirely. It slices raw images into sixteen-by-sixteen flat patches. Feeding them directly into standard transformer blocks.
beats.visual_focus: An input image slicing neatly into a 14x14 grid of 16x16 pixel tiles, each flattening linearly into 768-dimensional token vectors marching into an encoder.

beats.text: Every patch attends to every other patch instantly. A global attention matrix learns long-range spatial relationships in a single parallel step.
beats.visual_focus: An NxN attention heatmap illuminating simultaneously. Glowing cyan arcs flash between distant patches, calculating pairwise token affinities across the entire image.
